summary.name: ImagineYourBook
summary.one_liner: An AI book-writing service that turns a story idea into a complete manuscript with a cover, exportable as Word or EPUB.
use_cases: Drafting a complete romance or fiction novel from a single idea
Writing a sequel that keeps characters and continuity from book one
Creating a personalized family storybook or gift book
Revising an existing manuscript into a new edition
Producing an ebook file and cover for Kindle self-publishing
summary.what_it_does: ImagineYourBook takes a prompt or outline and plans, then writes, a full-length book chapter by chapter, with a designed cover. Users can read and line-edit the draft in an online viewer and export it as Word, EPUB, or Markdown, with a Kindle send option. A series feature stores characters, world rules, and open threads in a story bible so later volumes continue the same world. Manuscript Rewrite lets users upload an existing manuscript of 1,000 to 200,000 words and describe changes such as adding chapters or shifting voice. The page lists two generation engines, Lyra (default) and Lyra Max (3x credits).
notable: Chapter-by-chapter generation with continuity tracking and a series story bible
Manuscript Rewrite for editing or expanding uploaded books up to 200,000 words
Exports Word, EPUB and high-res JPG cover; Kindle send
Paid plan after a card-required 7-day trial; credits can be bought once instead of a subscription
caveats: Subscription of $29.99/month after a 7-day trial that requires a card, unless canceled
Fully explicit scenes are not available; open-door content is for readers 18+
Books are text only with a cover, no illustrations inside
Generation can take from about 4 minutes to 180 minutes depending on book length
